detectors.name: missing_nonreentrant
detectors.description: Flags @external functions that perform external calls or value transfers without @nonreentrant.

detectors.name: unsafe_raw_call
detectors.description: Flags raw_call() invocations whose success is not asserted or checked.

detectors.name: unchecked_send
detectors.description: Flags send() calls whose return value is not checked.

detectors.name: missing_event_emission
detectors.description: Flags @external functions that modify state without emitting an event.

detectors.name: timestamp_dependence
detectors.description: Flags use of block.timestamp in conditional logic.

detectors.name: integer_overflow
detectors.description: Flags explicit unsafe arithmetic calls (unsafe_add/sub/mul/div) that bypass Vyper built-in overflow protection.

detectors.name: unprotected_selfdestruct
detectors.description: Flags selfdestruct() calls without access-control checks.

detectors.name: dangerous_delegatecall
detectors.description: Flags raw_call() with is_delegate_call=True.

detectors.name: unprotected_state_change
detectors.description: Flags writes to sensitive state variables (owner, admin, ...) without msg.sender checks.

detectors.name: send_in_loop
detectors.description: Flags send()/raw_call() inside unbounded loops (DoS risk).

detectors.name: unchecked_subtraction
detectors.description: Flags self.x -= y without a preceding sufficient-balance/assertion guard.

detectors.name: cei_violation
detectors.description: Flags external calls that occur before state updates (Checks-Effects-Interactions violation).

detectors.name: compiler_version_check
detectors.description: Always-on pragma/version vulnerability checks for known Vyper compiler advisories.

detectors.name: tx_origin_auth
detectors.description: Detects use of tx.origin for authentication; use msg.sender for access control.

detectors.name: missing_zero_address_check
detectors.description: Detects assignment to address state variables without a preceding non-zero address assertion.

detectors.name: weak_randomness
detectors.description: Detects predictable block properties used as randomness sources.

detectors.name: locked_ether
detectors.description: Detects payable contracts with no send/raw_call withdrawal mechanism.

detectors.name: shadowed_state_variable
detectors.description: Detects local variables that shadow contract-level state variables.

detectors.name: missing_input_validation
detectors.description: Detects external amount/value entry points without explicit assert-based input validation.

detectors.name: unsafe_assembly
detectors.description: Detects inline assembly signals that bypass Vyper safety guarantees.

detectors.name: missing_return_value
detectors.description: Detects external interface calls whose return value is discarded.

detectors.name: division_before_multiplication
detectors.description: Detects precision-loss patterns where integer division happens before multiplication.

detectors.name: incorrect_erc20_return
detectors.description: Detects ERC-20 transfer/transferFrom calls whose boolean return value is not asserted.
